messages:
pagerbot: ALERT — Route53 healthchecks reporting STALE probes for us-west-2 (region). 60% of health-check responses older than 120s. PD: INC-12456. Auto-paged: @sam

sam: ack, picking this up. seeing a spike in DNS latency graphs. not yet sure if Route53 or our exporter. digging in.

lee: +1, I'm pulling the monitoring cluster logs and the probe-agent fleet status. attaching quick dump in a sec.

maria: flagged on the customer dashboard — a handful of Dedicated customers show elevated 5xx for model-serving endpoints in us-west-2. unclear if traffic is routing to fallback region.

sam: runbook check: route-health-check -> if >50% stale, consider disabling healthcheck-based routing and fail traffic to healthy region. I'll run the precheck.

ops-runbook: runbook snippet:
```
# quick check commands
dig +short @8.8.8.8 service.example.us-west-2  # expect IPs
curl -sS https://proxy-us-west-2.internal/health 
kubectl -n monitoring logs deploy/probe-agent --since=10m | tail -n 200
```

lee: probe-agent logs show repeated timeout to Route53 endpoint, sequence: GET /health -> timeout 504 from resolver, then retries. sample: 
```
2026-03-15T02:30:12Z probe-agent[pid=234] WARN resolver timeout (attempt 1)
2026-03-15T02:30:18Z probe-agent[pid=234] WARN resolver timeout (attempt 2)
2026-03-15T02:30:25Z probe-agent[pid=234] ERROR stale result, age=145s
```

sam: okay that suggests a network path problem from our probe fleet to Route53 (or upstream DNS resolver). can someone trace from an affected VPC?

maria: I launched an ad-hoc bastion in the customer VPC and ran `dig` — response times ~1.2s and sometimes NXDOMAIN followed by OK.

jess: I'm online and will take the official handoff if this stretches past the next 20m. prepping shift notes.

sam: mitigation plan (short):
- disable healthcheck-based failover policy for the affected record set (manual) to stop flapping
- increase probe timeout and switch resolver to a different resolver pool for probe VMs
- announce possible >30s DNS resolution increase to SRE on-call and support
- open SEV ticket for Cloud provider networking in us-west-2

lee: on config change: I can flip the record set from FAILOVER to MULTIVALUE with static fallback IPs, but prefer minimal change: toggle healthcheck evaluation off for the record temporarily. ready to perform when sam gives go.

sam: go for toggle. leaving a note: "toggled healthcheck evaluation off at 02:45Z to stop circuit thrash — will re-enable after provider confirms stable"

pagerbot: SYSTEM — DNS recordset update executed by sam at 1790248750. Route53 config change propagated (status: initiated).

maria: after toggle, customer 5xx rates dropped ~40% and DNS latency stabilized to ~200-300ms. still occasional spikes.

lee: started rolling probe-agent resolver change to alt-resolver pool (10% -> 50% traffic). patch command run: `kubectl set env deploy/probe-agent RESOLVER_POOL=alt-resolver`

sam: opened Cloud provider ticket with traceroutes attached. provider acknowledged networking blip in a subset of us-west-2 AZs, investigating internal LB -> resolver path.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled handover to @jess in 12m. Please prepare summary + links.

sam: handover summary for @jess:
- issue: Route53 probe telemetry stale, causing healthcheck-driven routing instability for us-west-2; impacted Dedicated customers saw 5xx and elevated DNS latency
- actions taken: toggled healthcheck evaluation off (02:45Z), started probe-agent resolver switch (partial), opened provider ticket, monitoring showing partial recovery
- outstanding: provider investigation, need to re-enable healthchecks once probe telemetry stable and provider confirms path healthy. follow-up: file post-incident runbook update (probe timeouts + alternate resolver strategy)

jess: taking over at 02:57Z. I'll keep the policy off until we have explicit green from provider and stable metrics for 30m. will also coordinate with support to notify impacted customers. pls ping if anything changes. :white_check_mark:

sam: thanks — handing off to @jess. marking INC-12456 as in progress and assigning to jess for next steps.

maria: added a temporary status note to the customer portal and created a support escalation ticket linking this incident.

lee: will collate logs and attach to the incident ticket. planning to run a post-incident query to find similar stale-probe windows in past 30 days.

pagerbot: NOTE — auto-closure rule: thread will be archived after 7 days if no follow-up.

jess: acknowledged. I'll update threads when provider gives full RCA or if we re-enable the healthchecks.
